== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Water [[madra]] is one of the seven primary [[aspects of madra]], alongside fire, earth, wind, force, blood, and life. It is a common energy in the [[Desolate Wilds]] due to the prevalence of [[Purelake School]] disciples. Practitioners of this aspect, known as [[water artists]], can manipulate nature to perform feats such as summoning rain or walking upon the ocean. While it is possible for a user to focus enough to force water [[madra]] into a solid shape, such forms are temporary. In combat and technique application, water [[madra]] can manifest as powerful physical forces, such as serpentine [[dragons]] or crushing maelstroms that carry the weight of an ocean. It can also be used to create constructs, such as a miniature woman forged from the element. Specialized forms of this energy exist, including [[Ghostwater|ghostwater]] and aquatic [[madra]]. When interacting with a user's internal systems, water [[madra]] can have soothing effects, such as calming the flow of dark [[madra]] or relieving the sensation of a burn within the [[madra channels]].}}
